name: OpenSpace
summary: Skill management layer for AI agents that retrieves, evaluates, shares and evolves skills with real-task evidence.
description: OpenSpace manages the lifecycle of agent skills: it organises skill packages, retrieves the right skill per task, records real-task evidence to score quality, and evolves skills from outcomes. It plugs into agents such as Claude Code, Codex, OpenClaw, Hermès and nanobot, and ships a CLI, Python API, MCP server, gateway, dashboard and TUI with a local-first skill hub.
contains: skill lifecycle: retrieve, evaluate, share, evolve
v2 (2026-07-17) adds package browsing, quality summaries, task-trace uploads, dashboard and TUI
plugs into agents as skills: Claude Code, Codex, OpenClaw, Hermès, nanobot
skill quality judged from real run records and uploaded task traces
local-first: cloud is for skill discovery, the local machine for execution
interfaces: CLI, Python API, MCP (stdio, SSE, streamable HTTP), gateway, dashboard
